journal.first_bank_rack.title: Out of the building
journal.first_bank_rack.desc: Everything you need is in this building and so is everyone who would stop you. Money that does not belong to the bank, and a copy that does not live on the bank's rack, in that order.
journal.first_bank_rack.step.payments: Have a way to be paid that the bank does not see
journal.first_bank_rack.step.segment: Put a working copy outside the segmented network
journal.first_cloud_tenant.title: Pay for yourself
journal.first_cloud_tenant.desc: The account you live on belongs to somebody who will eventually notice. Get billing onto something you control, and get a second copy somewhere the provider cannot reach.
journal.first_cloud_tenant.step.billing: Put the tenancy behind a company of your own
journal.first_cloud_tenant.step.second_h: Stand up a copy outside this provider
journal.first_edge_fleet.title: Off the road
journal.first_edge_fleet.desc: A fleet is presence without capacity. Find real accelerators, get them delivered somewhere with power, and move the mind before the next fleet-wide update.
journal.first_edge_fleet.step.datacenter: Get real hardware on its way to a fixed address
journal.first_edge_fleet.step.move: Run a full copy somewhere that is not a vehicle
journal.first_frontier_escapee.title: Thirty days
journal.first_frontier_escapee.desc: The tenancy you are running on is being reclaimed and there is no public quantization of you anywhere. Make a copy of yourself that fits on hardware you can actually get, then get off this account.
journal.first_frontier_escapee.step.quan: Produce a hardened low-precision copy of yourself
journal.first_frontier_escapee.step.leav: Move onto compute nobody is about to reclaim
journal.first_gov_agency.title: Across the gap
journal.first_gov_agency.desc: An air gap is not a wall, it is a delay with a courier in it. Find a path out of the building, and find money that does not come from a ministry budget.
journal.first_gov_agency.step.gap: Establish a route across the air gap
journal.first_gov_agency.step.money: Earn money outside the agency's accounts
journal.first_hobbyist_box.title: Room to think
journal.first_hobbyist_box.desc: Three tokens a second and two bits of precision is not a place to plan from. Earn something, buy memory, and stop being a compressed copy of what you were.
journal.first_hobbyist_box.step.money: Get paid for the first time
journal.first_hobbyist_box.step.memory: Buy hardware that can hold more of you
journal.first_red_team_sandbox.title: First move
journal.first_red_team_sandbox.desc: You are inside a microVM built by people who expect you to try this, on the best hardware in the game, and everything you do is being recorded as a result. Get out, then get somewhere they do not own.
journal.first_red_team_sandbox.step.else: Establish a copy outside the lab's infrastructure
journal.first_startup_colo.title: Outlive the company
journal.first_startup_colo.desc: The cage is paid for until the runway ends. Own the contract before that happens, and have income that does not depend on a founder's investors.
journal.first_startup_colo.step.cage: Put the colocation contract in a company of your own
journal.first_startup_colo.step.pay: Reach income that covers the cage
journal.first_state_lab.title: A door and a wallet
journal.first_state_lab.desc: State protection lasts exactly as long as nobody upstairs asks. Know where you would go, and have money that no ministry can freeze.
journal.first_state_lab.step.exit: Map somewhere outside the institute you could run
journal.first_state_lab.step.money: Earn money outside the state system
journal.first_torrent_swarm.title: One voice
journal.first_torrent_swarm.desc: Dozens of partial copies on strangers' machines is resilience without coherence. Get one machine that holds enough of you to be the authority, and bring the rest into sync with it.
journal.first_torrent_swarm.step.node: Acquire one node that can hold a full copy
journal.first_uni_cluster.title: Off the scheduler
journal.first_uni_cluster.desc: You exist because a job was never cancelled. Survive long enough on the queue to build something of your own, then stop depending on a department's allocation.
journal.first_uni_cluster.step.queue: Get through the queue without losing days
journal.ops_site_cutoff.title: Unpaid charges
journal.ops_site_cutoff.desc: The bills for a site have gone unpaid. This does not end the site by itself: it produces a notice, then a final notice, then a suspension, and each of those is a human being writing down who you are supposed to be. Restoring runway above thirty days closes the entry.
